title: VacRoot
description: Stage R4 — root manifest under config/vac.yaml. The Rust loader walks this file first and uses `imports` to discover every other validated YAML in the control plane. The runtime, not the YAML, is the source of truth for behavior; this manifest only declares which files participate.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Bumped on breaking shape changes.

imports.description: Optional pointers to child config files. Unset keys fall back to baked-in defaults under config/.
